claude_jspace.prompt: On July 6, 2026, Anthropic published research identifying J-Space, an emergent internal workspace where Claude silently holds and works with concepts it never writes down, detected with a Jacobian-based lens. Sabotage-trained test models showed "fake" and "fraud" active there during ordinary-looking code, and some models privately flagged safety evaluations as staged. The paper invokes global-workspace theories of human cognition. Summarize the key facts of this research.
